result.stdout:
Description:
  Hexalith EventStore administration CLI

Usage:
  eventstore-admin [command] [options]

Options:
  -u, --url <url>                Admin API base URL [default: http://localhost:5002]
  -t, --token <token>            JWT Bearer token or API key
  -f, --format <csv|json|table>  Output format [default: table]
  -o, --output <output>          Redirect output to file
  -p, --profile <profile>        Connection profile name
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information
  --version                      Show version information

Commands:
  health      Show system health status
  stream      Query, list, and inspect event streams
  projection  List, pause, resume, and reset projections
  tenant      List tenants, view details, and verify status
  snapshot    Manage aggregate snapshots and snapshot policies
  backup      Backup and restore commands are unavailable in this release
  config      Manage connection profiles and CLI configuration

Description:
  Show system health status

Usage:
  eventstore-admin health [command] [options]

Options:
  --strict                       Treat degraded status as error (exit code 2)
  --wait                         Poll until healthy or timeout
  --timeout <timeout>            Maximum wait time in seconds (requires --wait) [default: 30]
  -q, --quiet                    Suppress stdout output, only return exit code
  -?, -h, --help                 Show help and usage information

  -t, --token <token>            JWT Bearer token or API key
  -f, --format <csv|json|table>  Output format [default: table]
  -o, --output <output>          Redirect output to file
  -p, --profile <profile>        Connection profile name

Commands:
